recipe.criteria: Alternating hanging knee raises with a 25-degree pelvic turn toward the lifting side. Knees bend as thighs rise to hip height, then straighten under control. Each side takes 1.5 seconds up, 1 second pause, 1.5 seconds down; stable grip and upper trunk.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
